credit.credit-words: The Touch of His Hand on Mine
WORDS: Jessie B. Pounds, 1913. MUSIC: Henry P. Morton. Public Domain.
With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him. Psa. 89:21 He touched her hand, and the fever left her. Mt. 8:15 Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him. 14:31
